playbackReference.method: Median strongest-50ms RMS of the live game's six existing melee/bow cues, including the game master gain. Match toward that digital output at the board's 55% reference volume. Other volume settings scale normally. Current game cues reproduce their original relative gains; base/library profiles of authored quiet edits retain zero makeup gain. Event-specific attack and ordinary-terrain gains may adjust these to their corresponding game range.
playbackReference.eventRangePolicy: Clamp attack and ordinary-terrain events to their existing game min/max strongest-50ms RMS ranges; retain gains already in range. Quarry/mine and bell tiles retain their authored levels. Selection and shared movement are unchanged.

method: Decoded mono listening copies; sample peak, whole-range RMS, strongest half-overlapping 50ms RMS. dBFS is not acoustic SPL or perceived loudness. Playback levels include the selected per-range profile (or legacy catalog gain) and app volume; no device/system gain.
quietFlag: Playback strongest 50ms RMS below -38 dBFS; diagnostic heuristic, not an automatic mastering target. This flag describes the base profile; context-specific event levels are reported separately.
